messages:
morgan: Wrapping up the postmortem follow-ups. I want a tight action table for execs and a short summary of recurring failure modes. Drop confirmations and any blockers here.

liam: I9ll own routing policy changes. Plan: add health-gating, lower TTLs for critical records, and document fallback ordering (prefer regional warm standby, then global CDN). Will sketch a ruleset by Friday.

june: storage note: our snapshot merges intermittently time out when disk utilization > 80%. Proposing a consolidation window and a pre-merge check that delays merges if pressure is high. Owner: june. ETA Tue.

sara: Taking runbooks. I9ll add a restore checklist that includes: 1) verify snapshot integrity (sha256), 2) mount + smoke tests (auth, queueing), 3) post-restore metric baselines. Draft PR by Mon.

anika: I can run the game-day and coordinate participants. Suggest running a tabletop first then a live failover dry-run. Proposing Apr 8 10-12 PT for the live run; tabletop week prior. ops-bot can you put tentative holds?

ops-bot: Tentative holds added: Tabletop 2026-04-01 10:00-11:00 PT, Dry-run 2026-04-08 10:00-12:00 PT.

derek: I9ll do the CRR/S3 audit and KMS reconciliation. Found one bucket with stale replication config already (will include in audit). Delivery Fri COB.

liam: quick example snippet for gating (Route53 + health):
```yaml
failover:
  primary: eu-central-1
  secondary: us-west-2
  health_checks:
    live_endpoint: /healthz
    failure_threshold: 3
    evaluation_interval: 15s
  ttl: 30
```

sara: Question on smoke test approach: synthetic probes vs small live replay? Synthetic faster and safer but might miss e2e regressions.

june: Agree with hybrid: synthetic probes for every run, small sampled replay for critical transactions (auth, billing). Keep replay size small to limit side effects.

anika: For the tabletop, we9ll script the roles and escalation contacts into the agenda. Also include a short rollback drill to validate runbook steps.

storage-bot: Alert triggered earlier: snapshot.merge.timeout on node storage-13. See incident 3329998001 for logs.

morgan: RACI snapshot (short):
- Routing changes: R=liam, A=morgan, C=infra-net, I=platform/SRE
- Restore runbook: R=sara, A=morgan, C=storage, I=oncall
- Snapshot consolidation policy: R=june, A=morgan, C=storage-ops, I=eng-storage
- CRR/KMS audit: R=derek, A=morgan, C=security, I=storage team
- Game-day ops: R=anika, A=morgan, C=infra/events, I=DR owners

derek: also adding a small script to detect buckets without replication: `aws s3api get-bucket-replication --bucket <name>` and a dry-run apply script. Will attach to the audit.

morgan: Owners, please post a one-line status update by EOD today so I can publish a single tracker row per item. Also call out any slip risk.

liam: Status: drafting policy, need infra review. ETA Fri for PR.

sara: Status: runbook draft in Confluence (link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/restore-draft). PR incoming Mon.

june: Status: drafting pre-merge checks and alerting rule. ETA Tue.

dan: tagging in case of infra scheduling conflicts for the dry-run (not in thread participants but FYI).

anika: Status: tabletop agenda done, waiting on participant confirmations. Dry-run tentative holds set.

derek: Status: audit started; found 1 bucket with replication off and 2 with missing KMS grants. Will propose remediation steps Fri.

morgan: Summary of recurring patterns for exec slide: 
1) routing fallback during peering instability -> fixes: health-gating, TTL tuning, clarify fallback order
2) snapshot consolidation failures under disk pressure -> fixes: pre-merge checks, schedule windows, alerting rule
3) replication configuration drift (CRR/KMS) -> fixes: audit + automated remediation scripts

morgan: I9ll merge these into a concise tracker tomorrow morning and ping execs. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks all.
